message: Hey Jane, how's your day going? Anything interesting happening at work?
Thank you for the session today, Jane. Emily felt much better after talking to you.
The stress management workshop was a success. The students gave great feedback!
Good morning! Hope you have a great day ahead. Let me know how the workshop goes.
Reminder: Tomorrow's workshop starts at 9 AM. Don't forget to bring the handouts.
Jane, please submit the monthly report on student counseling sessions by Friday.
Hi Jane, Emily has been feeling overwhelmed with the exams. Can we schedule a session?
Are you free for a call this evening? Would love to hear about your week!
Don't worry about the reports, I'll cover for you this time. Enjoy your weekend!
All staff, please remember to update your availability for parent-teacher meetings next week.
